{"assessments":[{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选以KTV临场提升为切入，给出先做蹲起或高抬腿活动身体的具体办法，观点完整且有应用场景；部分语句重复，身体训练建议需要审慎审核。","candidate_id":"candidate_b66177d9d0ec57ef","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"唱歌前可通过少量蹲起或高抬腿活动身体，帮助进入演唱状态。","risk_summary":"包含唱歌前进行身体运动的具体建议，需注意个体身体状况与安全边界。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"KTV唱歌前的快速热身方法","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选明确指出胸口明显起伏可能代表吸气过浅，并开始说明俯身寻找发力位置的方法；开头承接前文，且“这个位置”等表达需要画面辅助确认。","candidate_id":"candidate_259a47e73cd8edad","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["visual_verification_required"],"primary_claim":"吸气时胸口起伏明显可能说明气息较浅，可借助俯身姿势感受较低的呼吸支撑位置。","risk_summary":"呼吸判断和身体姿势依赖未提供的示范画面，并涉及身体训练建议。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"唱歌呼吸位置与丹田感受","uncertainty_flags":["visual_dependency"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选用课堂问答引出“唱歌第一步是吸气”，随后提供把手放在胸口并缓慢鼻吸的自测方法， setup、观点和动作说明较完整。","candidate_id":"candidate_f14a3fb4d68e51ca","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"唱歌首先要处理吸气，并可通过观察胸口变化来检查自己的吸气方式。","risk_summary":"包含呼吸方式与身体自测建议，发布前宜审慎核对其适用范围。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"唱歌第一步与吸气自测","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选主要是连麦征集、设备调试和直播画面安排，内容可以理解，但缺少可供独立观众获得的实质知识或完整故事。","candidate_id":"candidate_349a7ccecf8c6857","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"主播需要通过连麦听取声音，正在调整设备和画面以便进行声音诊断。","risk_summary":"局部转写混乱，尤其是设备与声音诊断相关语句不够稳定。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"直播连麦与设备调试","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选从互动反馈转入呼吸判断，核心意思是胸口明显起伏代表气息浅，但文本存在重复、杂音式插入，并在介绍正确通道时中断。","candidate_id":"candidate_f501d39592c1669b","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","context_dependency","incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"吸气时胸口明显起伏可能意味着气息较浅，难以形成所说的唱歌气息支撑。","risk_summary":"转写重复且结尾未完成，同时包含呼吸机制方面的训练判断。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":1},"topic_hypothesis":"通过胸口起伏判断唱歌气息","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","missing_context"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选给出俯身、扶腰感受呼吸起伏的方法，并列举头腔、鼻腔、口腔、胸腔与气息支撑构成的唱歌通道；方法具体，但指示位置依赖示范画面。","candidate_id":"candidate_c393f29d34250a55","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["visual_verification_required"],"primary_claim":"可通过俯身扶腰感受较低位置的呼吸起伏，并把多种共鸣区域和气息支撑理解为整体唱歌通道。","risk_summary":"姿势和身体位置需要画面核实，且涉及呼吸与发声训练建议。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"感受气息支撑与理解唱歌通道","uncertainty_flags":["visual_dependency"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选直接列出零基础常见的高音卡挤、破音和大白嗓问题，并用声带弹性作解释，具有明确痛点和较强开场；末尾转入下一段教学问题，闭合略弱。","candidate_id":"candidate_29b8beefbb32b85b","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"零基础演唱者的高音卡挤或破音可能与大白嗓式发声及不当用力有关。","risk_summary":"少量转写词语不稳定，且对声带和高音问题作了身体机制方面的解释。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"零基础高音卡挤与破音原因","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选依次给出气息练习、练声和正式唱歌的时间安排，并解释练声过久可能导致疲劳，信息具体、结构清楚；结尾混入课程和提问内容。","candidate_id":"candidate_fa0cd44fc3dcaa6b","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"气息练习可利用短暂零碎时间，练声以约十到二十分钟、找到状态后再唱歌为宜。","risk_summary":"包含训练时长和疲劳方面的建议，并提及主播自己的课程。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"气息、练声与唱歌的时间分配","uncertainty_flags":["mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"low","assessment_reason":"候选试图强调唱歌第一步会影响高音，但没有在本段清楚揭示或解释该步骤，且大量点赞、关注和直播互动话术打断主线，转写也较混乱。","candidate_id":"candidate_f39a280e9d55f06e","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim","sponsor_or_advertising"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","context_dependency","incomplete_claim"],"primary_claim":"唱歌起始步骤若处理不当，可能加重高音卡挤，而气息是后续训练的基础。","risk_summary":"核心教学内容未完整展开、转写混乱，并夹杂明显的直播关注引导。","scores":{"content_value":1,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":1},"topic_hypothesis":"唱歌第一步与高音卡挤","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","missing_context","mixed_topics","claim_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选把舞台表情紧张与高音发力、舌根用力联系起来，并引出吸气时胸口和面部不应明显动作的原则；观点可恢复，但“三个原则”没有在本段讲完。","candidate_id":"candidate_f0bbb75c02ac39ed","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["incomplete_claim","visual_verification_required"],"primary_claim":"唱高音时的紧张可能导致面部和舌根代偿用力，初学者吸气时应尽量避免胸口和面部出现多余动作。","risk_summary":"训练原则未完整列出，动作表现依赖画面确认，并涉及发声与身体用力建议。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":2,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"高音紧张、面部代偿与吸气原则","uncertainty_flags":["visual_dependency"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选反复表达胸口起伏明显代表气息浅，并以“气沉丹田”概括正确方向；重复和疑似错字较多，但核心观点仍可识别。","candidate_id":"candidate_58a59476ab12c657","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain","context_dependency"],"primary_claim":"吸气时胸口明显起伏可能表示气息过浅，唱歌需要寻找更低的气息支撑感。","risk_summary":"文本存在明显重复和疑似错转，同时包含呼吸位置方面的训练判断。","scores":{"content_value":2,"editorial_utility":1,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":1,"standalone_completeness":2},"topic_hypothesis":"胸口起伏与浅呼吸判断","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","missing_context"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选针对高音时舌头后缩提出诊断框架，建议先区分气息和咬字问题，并在中音区解决后再处理高音；核心建议明确，末尾的“邪修”预告削弱闭合。","candidate_id":"candidate_f89ea722be8ee018","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"高音时舌头后缩不应只靠蛮力纠正，应先在中音区排查并改善气息或咬字问题。","risk_summary":"少量术语疑似转写失真，且内容涉及舌头用力和发声训练建议。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"高音舌头后缩的排查方法","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选解释了拿着谱仍跟不上伴奏的原因，并建议先熟悉歌曲，让注意力能够转向伴奏律动；主体完整实用，但“古典”等词明显可能是转写错误，后段转为直播闲聊。","candidate_id":"candidate_f49be10488a46e67","content_risk_flags":[],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"跟不上伴奏往往是因为歌曲尚未熟悉、注意力被音高占满，应先熟悉歌曲再专注聆听伴奏节奏。","risk_summary":"伴奏与律动相关的若干词语疑似转写错误。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":2,"hook_strength":2,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"看谱演唱却跟不上伴奏的原因","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity","mixed_topics"],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"high","assessment_reason":"候选提出有反常识感的阶段性建议：抬眉并非所有学习者都适用，初学者应优先放松，后期才可能用作细节调整；论点、理由和适用人群均较完整。","candidate_id":"candidate_464b0f2aee1d8a44","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":[],"primary_claim":"抬眉唱高音属于阶段性的细节技巧，不适合零基础学习者一开始使用，初学者应先保持面部放松。","risk_summary":"包含面部用力与高音训练的身体技巧建议，需要注意个体差异。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":4,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"初学者是否应该抬眉唱高音","uncertainty_flags":[],"unusable_reason":"none"},{"assessment_confidence":"medium","assessment_reason":"候选直接回应“如何找到共鸣”，主张不要孤立追求头腔共鸣，而应先建立整体唱歌通道；观点鲜明且重复强化，但部分术语被转写为“投降共鸣”。","candidate_id":"candidate_0c49c6488ae5fe28","content_risk_flags":["health_or_safety_claim"],"disposition":"assessable","evidence_flags":["asr_uncertain"],"primary_claim":"共鸣不宜被孤立、刻意追求，先进入合适的唱歌通道，音调提高时相应共鸣会自然出现。","risk_summary":"关键共鸣术语存在疑似转写错误，且内容涉及具体发声训练主张。","scores":{"content_value":3,"editorial_utility":3,"evidence_fidelity":3,"hook_strength":3,"standalone_completeness":3},"topic_hypothesis":"不要刻意寻找头腔共鸣","uncertainty_flags":["asr_ambiguity"],"unusable_reason":"none"}]}
